wiringInterpretation.rationale: Plan_final 07-010 wires Quit Game confirmation, the randomized quit-prompt text, and ENDOOM display into the clean-quit path via a single src/vanilla re-export facade (wireQuitAndEndoomUi.ts) over the read-only src/ui/endoom.ts (80x25 / 4000-byte VGA text parser) and src/bootstrap/quitFlow.ts (I_AtExit LIFO cleanup model), plus a frozen VANILLA_QUIT_ENDOOM_INVARIANTS manifest pinning four parity rules: (1) quit is gated by a randomized yes/no confirmation whose prompt vanilla M_QuitDOOM selects from endmsg[] by gametic % NUM_QUITMESSAGES (the quitGame MenuAction was pinned upstream by 07-003); (2) a confirmed quit drains the I_AtExit stack in LIFO order (QuitFlow.executeQuit -> CANONICAL_QUIT_ORDER); (3) ENDOOM is shown immediately after I_ShutdownGraphics (CANONICAL_QUIT_ORDER[0]=I_ShutdownGraphics, [1]=D_Endoom); (4) ENDOOM is the canonical 80x25 / 4000-byte / 2000-cell VGA text screen decoded by parseEndoom. The focused test exercises real parseEndoom decode + RangeError, the LIFO executeQuit drain, the post-graphics ENDOOM position, and same-reference identity with the read-only modules. Pure barrel + frozen manifest; no read-only source modified. Facade placed in src/vanilla/ per the established 07-001..07-006/07-009 convention (07-004 set precedent for src/vanilla/ placement when the write lock omits it).
